title.en: Authorizing Stock Transactions By Members of An Operating Stock Exchange Through Members of Any Other Operating Stock Exchanges When Necessary to Execute Customers' Orders

text.en:
Any provision of law or decree to the contrary notwithstanding, any and all brokers of an
operating stock exchange are hereby authorized to transact and/or execute orders through members of any
other operating stock exchanges when necessary in the interest of customers, pursuant to such terms and
conditions as may be mutually agreed upon between the executing brokers, provided, that the customer shall
not pay more than the authorized commission, and an appropriate report on the matter is submitted to the
Securities and Exchange Commission.

The Securities and Exchange Commission is hereby authorized to promulgate such rules and
regulations as may be necessary to implement this Decree, and to impose fines, suspension or revocation of
license of the guilty partly for any violation thereof, as provided under existing laws.

Any and all laws, decrees, rules or regulations contrary to, or in conflict with, any provisions of
this Decree are hereby repealed or modified accordingly.

This Decree shall take effect immediately.
Done in the City of Manila, this 30th day of August, in the year of Our Lord, nineteen hundred and
seventy-three.
